Massage Chair for Back Pain

Massage can ease low back pain in the short term, and the American College of Physicians lists it among first-choice options for acute and subacute back pain, alongside heat. But a 2015 Cochrane review had very little confidence in massage overall, and those studies used hands-on massage, not chairs. A massage chair is a reasonable comfort tool for everyday aches; for severe, new or worsening pain, see a doctor first.
